documents.title: Monroe County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 76 pages. Amounts are the Ordinance 641 'Appropriated Amount' / 'Budget' for offices and funds; budget detail report 'Original Budget' Group Totals for categories column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
